notes.title: Update Beta v0.7.8!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33911737/13edbcf3ae589c544ceec408b2828e53547a5ae7.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hello to all![/b][/h1]

We are pleased to present you the long-awaited update for the game!

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Russian localization
[*] Improved Kamikaze Cow! Now Kamikaze Cow can explode from damage inflicted by it causing a chain reaction of nearby Kamikaze Cows, causing damage to other cows and towers.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33911737/27e5aa386e9e4dce2133251fbcde0e3e9d031307.gif[/img]

[*] Added a menu with a description of hot keys.
[*] Added Waterfall level 4 - Rise of the Machines - Story
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33911737/8de3c11ceeb21a61560174d66b17828bd9cf456b.png[/img]

[*] Added Waterfall level 5 - Unmasked! - Story
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33911737/4127fb24888421e0d36e7043bde90ef126b91b67.gif[/img]

[*] Added new opponents
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33911737/8a1c3bfec443a3643c764c29bfb8eadb03f0be3c.gif[/img]
[/list]


[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Errors related to Achievements on Steam.
[*] Also minor fixes for UI, balance, bugs, and game optimization.
[/list]
